title: How Starbucks spilled coffee on its digital strategy with loyalty changes

facts.fact: Starbucks Rewards changed from a frequency-based model to a spend-based model, in which free drinks are awarded based on how much money customers spend over time.
facts.quote: Starbucks Rewards was previously built around the frequency of customer visits, but is now based on giving out free drinks based on how much money customers spend over time.

facts.fact: Starbucks reported nearly 2 million new Rewards members year-over-year, representing 18% growth.
facts.quote: We entered nearly 2 million new members year-over-year, representing 18% growth, and 300,000 net new members in Q3 alone

facts.fact: Starbucks reported 12.3 million active Rewards members in the US.
facts.quote: And we now have 12.3 million active Reward members in the US and millions more worldwide.

facts.fact: Starbucks reported 300,000 net new Rewards members in Q3 alone.
facts.quote: 300,000 net new members in Q3 alone, a time of year when we often see flat to negative membership growth.

facts.fact: The percentage of tender from Starbucks Rewards U.S. customers rose to 33% in Q3, up three full points from last year.
facts.quote: the percentage of tender from Starbucks Rewards U.S. customers rise to 33% in Q3, up three full points from last year

facts.fact: Starbucks COO Kevin Johnson said the company delayed its normal Summer 1 campaign launch by one week to make room for Rewards training and launch.
facts.quote: we delayed our normal Summer 1 campaign launch by one week.

facts.fact: Starbucks Rewards membership grew nearly 20% year-on-year, according to COO Kevin Johnson.
facts.quote: with nearly 20% year-on-year growth in membership.

facts.fact: Starbucks says it has navigated a one-time transition to its new Starbucks Rewards program and plans to drive its Summer 2 marketing campaign around cold drinks.
facts.quote: We have navigated the onetime event of transitioning to the new Starbucks Rewards program and our actions going forward are clear - drive the Summer 2 marketing campaign around cold

facts.fact: Starbucks states it continues to execute against seven core strategies for growth.
facts.quote: continue to execute against our seven core strategies for growth
